task.title: Project one unified workflow-run lifecycle status
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/712 under decision https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/711 by classifying validated workflow-run state without changing persistence or evidence accessors.
acceptance_criteria: Expose evidence-free Active, Paused, AuthoredTerminal, Cancelled, and Failed classifications through one read-only accessor.
Classify failure and cancellation ahead of retained pause markers while preserving every exact reason and diagnostic accessor.
Preserve existing topology-specific terminal and lifecycle predicates without schema, replay, storage, or mutation changes.
Return exact classifications after reopen and through deterministic listing.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow-run target failed because WorkflowRunStatus and WorkflowRun::status did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added assertions for active, paused, resumed, authored-terminal, cancelled, active-failed, paused-failed, exact reopen, and deterministic listing states.

attempts.diagnostic: Deriving status from validated projected state avoided duplicate persisted authority and retained distinct topology, cancellation, pause, and failure semantics.
attempts.patch: Added the non-exhaustive copyable status enum, read-only accessor, explicit precedence, ADR-0016, and milestone documentation.

attempts.summary: Hardened paused cancellation coverage before commit.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent review identified one low-severity precedence coverage gap for cancellation retaining a pause marker.
attempts.patch: Asserted that cancellation while paused classifies as Cancelled, reran verification, and preserved the exact head until the Rust gate, substantive CodeRabbit review, and zero unresolved threads were confirmed.

outcome.summary: Every durable workflow run now exposes one deterministic lifecycle status while exact underlying reasons, diagnostics, and retained pause evidence remain separately available.

lessons: A lifecycle classifier should be a projection when validated state already contains all authoritative evidence.
Authored terminal arrival must remain distinct from success because topology currently declares no outcome semantics.
Failure and cancellation override retained pause markers for classification without erasing the underlying evidence.
A successful-looking rate-limited review is insufficient; merge must wait for substantive exact-head coverage and zero unresolved threads.
Read-only status classification grants no scheduling, execution, retry, recovery, compensation, or permission authority.
